subject: Re: Kickoff: Brush - June status: quality gap on outdoor scenes
body:
Status ahead of the M2 checkpoint.

Done: both ingestion paths are solid (synthetic-NeRF zips and COLMAP zips), and Bilal's harness now runs nightly - PSNR/SSIM on 8 standard scenes with per-commit regression tracking. The .ply viewer path also got a nice speedup from a kernel fix.

The gap: on indoor scenes we're within 0.4 dB PSNR of the reference 3DGS implementation, but on the two outdoor scenes we trail by 1.8-2.3 dB. Root cause is that we only do basic 'standard' Gaussian splatting - the reference results people compare against lean on post-release extensions (exposure handling, anti-aliasing) that Brush deliberately doesn't implement yet.

Trade-off for M2: implement exposure compensation (~3 weeks, Rafael thinks it closes most of the outdoor gap) or declare indoor-only scope for the LRB demo. Android build is fine btw, trains a small scene in 11 min on the test phones.

Need a call by Jun 19.

Hyun
